entities.summary: Archil Viktorovich Gelovani was a Soviet officer and later Marshal of the engineer troops, responsible for logistics, fortification and military infrastructure during and after World War II. He was tasked on several occasions with fortifying strategically important areas and also reconstruction, including all Black Sea ports during and after World War II. He served primarily on military engineering and defense strategy posts, including being the Deputy Minister of Defence and would play a major role in the structural development of the Soviet armed forces and strategic missile forces during the Cold War era.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a key figure in Soviet military engineering and defense strategy, Gelovani played a crucial role in fortifying strategic areas and reconstructing Black Sea ports during World War II. His contributions significantly impacted the structural development of the Soviet armed forces and strategic missile forces during the Cold War era.
